# Supported beds

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_adjustable_bed.py; do not edit. -->

HomeKit Adjustable Bed is checked against [Adjustable Bed](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed) **v4.4.2** ([`608dae3`](https://github.com/kristofferR/ha-adjustable-bed/commit/608dae3c7a46ab1858c370ca5eff4f4bfc154cf6)). Every bed type below works: HomeKit Adjustable Bed reads the entities Adjustable Bed creates for your bed, so a bed only gets the controls it really has. See [Detection](DETECTION.md) for the rules.

## Controls (982 entity keys)

Per group of the form, the number of entity keys (side variants count separately) and how they are recognised: by a rule, by a word in the key (a vendor control without a rule, off by default) or only by its domain (off by default, under Settings).

| Group | Keys | Rule | Keyword | Domain only | On by default |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Adjustable sections | 228 | 207 | 21 | 0 | 165 |
| Quick actions | 141 | 112 | 29 | 0 | 76 |
| Massage | 239 | 107 | 132 | 0 | 27 |
| Lighting | 113 | 37 | 76 | 0 | 13 |
| Climate | 16 | 13 | 3 | 0 | 7 |
| Firmness | 7 | 3 | 4 | 0 | 3 |
| Settings | 238 | 6 | 103 | 129 | 0 |

HomeKit types: push button 637, slider 239, switch per option 83, switch 10, fan (climate) 6, lamp 6, fan 1.

Timed adjustments (`adjustable_bed.timed_move`): `tv_lift`, `back`, `right_back`, `legs`, `head`, `feet`, `tilt`, `lumbar`, `bed_height`, `stair`, `m1x12_part_1`, `m1x12_part_2`, `m1x12_part_4`, `m1x12_part_8`, `m1x12_part_16`, `elevate_actuator_1`, `elevate_actuator_2`, `elevate_both`.
